upgrade.cardMethods: Card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay

purchaseError.store: The store checkout could not be completed and you have not been charged. Please try again in a moment.
purchaseError.validate: Your payment went through but activating it failed. Restart the app to retry - if it still does not unlock, the store refunds the purchase automatically within 3 days.
purchaseError.alreadyOwned: The store says you already own this, but it belongs to a different account. Sign in with the recovery phrase you were using when you bought it.

checkout.title: Welcome to the club
checkout.benefitDevicesSub: Phone, tablet, laptop, all in sync
checkout.benefitStorageSub: 10x the free plan. Add up to 5 GB more when you need it
checkout.benefitRoomSub: On top of your 500 MB Pro storage
checkout.benefitCancelSub: The space stays until the paid year ends
checkout.matchAccount: Match it at Settings > ID & Sync > Account ID. Different? Open checkout again from the app.
checkout.invalidBody: Open checkout from inside the app so we can attach the purchase to your account.
checkout.completeBody: You can close this tab and return to PrivacyNotes. Your upgrade unlocks automatically.
checkout.openingBody: A Paddle checkout window should appear. If it does not, your browser may have blocked the popup - reload this page to retry.

cryptoCheckout.coins: You pick Bitcoin, Ethereum, Lightning, USDC or USDT on the next page, run by BlockBee. It asks for no name and no email. A crypto payment is public on its blockchain.
cryptoCheckout.consent: Start Pro now. I understand that crypto payments are final, and I give up the 14-day right of withdrawal.
cryptoCheckout.consentNeeded: Tick the box above to continue.
cryptoCheckout.openingBody: BlockBee's payment page opens in this tab.
cryptoCheckout.waitingBody: Pay on the BlockBee page. The payment link works until {{time}}.
cryptoCheckout.seenBody: Your payment is on its way. Pro turns on when the network confirms it: Bitcoin usually takes 10 to 60 minutes, Ethereum and stablecoins about a minute. You can close this page.
cryptoCheckout.partialBody: Send the rest on the BlockBee page before {{time}}.
cryptoCheckout.expiredBody: No full payment arrived in time. Start again from the app. BlockBee does not count a payment sent after the link expired.
cryptoCheckout.alreadyProBody: There is nothing to pay. Crypto payments are final, so we do not take a second one.
cryptoCheckout.demoBody: The demo has no account to pay for. Sign up in the app, then buy Pro there.
cryptoCheckout.errorBody: The payment page did not open, and nothing was charged. Try again in a minute.

receipt.heading: Purchase confirmation
receipt.keep: Keep this page. It is your record of the purchase. We have no email address for you, so we cannot send it again.
receipt.productValue: PrivacyNotes Pro, one payment, for life
receipt.proOn: Pro is on for this account, for life. Sign in to it on any device to use it.
receipt.final: Crypto payments are final. There are no refunds.
receipt.withdrawal: You asked for Pro to start at once. You agreed that this ends the 14-day right of withdrawal that buyers in the EU and the UK have.
receipt.closeNote: You can close this tab and go back to PrivacyNotes.

history.subtitle: Up to 50 versions per item. Oldest auto-pruned.
history.replacedSubtitle: Text that a sync replaced on this device, kept here for {{days}} days.
history.empty: No history yet. Versions start piling up after the next edit. Come back later.
history.loadFailed: Could not load the history. Check your connection and try again.
history.restoreSnapshotFailed: Could not save the current version first, so nothing was restored. Check your connection and try again.
history.restoreFailed: Could not restore this version. Try again.
history.loginExtrasNotRecorded: This version did not record custom fields or additional websites. Restoring it keeps the current ones.
history.tooLong: This note is too long to compare.
history.trackersNotRecorded: This version did not record tracker values. Restoring it keeps the current ones.

donation.intro: <brand/> is free, and it always will be. No ads, no trackers, and no email on file unless you signed in with one. If it's helped you think, write, or remember, consider supporting development. It keeps the lights on and pays for the next features.
donation.proBenefits: Supporting also unlocks Pro benefits once they ship: unlimited devices, attachments, encrypted cloud backups.
